data.long_meaning: In Greek, Gerianne is derived from the name Geras, meaning 'venerable, aged'. The suffix -anne is often used in Greek to denote a female. The name is often associated with joy and light, symbolizing a shining or joyful one. The name Gerianne carries the meaning “Joyful, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerianne usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
